sourceText:
Peanut Butter Cookie Bars
By: Cresent
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:28am

Ingredients




1 cup Butter, melted
3/4 cup Brown sugar
3/4 cup Granulated sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 cup Chunky peanut butter
2 Eggs, beaten
1 cup x Plus ¼  all-purpose flour
1 cup Bran
3/4 cup Rolled oats
2 teaspoons Baking soda
Peanut butter candy pieces

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  2 In a small bowl with melted butter, beat in the brown sugar, granulated sugar, peanut butter and eggs. Set aside.  3 In a separate bowl, combine the flour, bran, oats and baking soda. Stir mixture into butter mixture.  4 In a glass baking dishes, press out half of dough mixture into each. Sprinkle peanut butter candy pieces across top of dough mixture. Cook until done, testing with toothpick, approximately 19 minutes.  5 Cook the rest of the batter, if desired or refrigerate for another time. Remove to rack to cool.To serve, cut into bars.
